name: qip-cost-router
purpose: Two things that are really one: a cost engine that converts data reads and compute work into the two self-charged deductions (ComputeCost, DataCost) NetEdge subtracts, and an intelligence-tier router (Router::select) that walks a 9-rung ladder from deterministic Rust to a solver and stops at the cheapest rung that is affordable, fast enough and strong enough. name: qip-evolution

name: qip-optimization-engine
purpose: DECIDE: portfolio optimisation plus the compute router between classical and quantum solvers. ComputeRouter::solve always runs the classical path, tries a quantum path only where problem structure could justify it, and returns the quantum answer only when feasible and better than the classical one by a stated margin — a tie goes to classical (ADR 0006 enforced structurally). Also holds the three-level strategy decomposition: families (correlation clustering under stress), horizons (capital-pool reconciliation) and tiers/universe (evaluation cadence, alpha-family taxonomy).
